name: FORTIS W1
summary: FORTIS W1, also called Futai, is Joyful Embodied’s self-developed wheeled humanoid for industrial and service work. description.en: FORTIS W1, also called Futai, is Joyful Embodied’s self-developed wheeled humanoid for industrial and service work. It combines a humanlike head and dual-arm upper body with a mobile base and dexterous hands. The manufacturer describes depth cameras on the head, chest and back, wrist cameras, and its in-house Yinzhi model as parts of the perception and control system. Intended applications include retail assistance, reception, bin handling, data collection, household tasks, production-line work and parcel sorting. It is publicly presented as a named product with a sales inquiry option; broad commercial shipment has not been independently established.
